description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the infrared face liveness detection operation DetectInfraredLivingFace
description_zh: 本文为您介绍红外人脸活体检测DetectInfraredLivingFace的语法及示例
name: DetectInfraredLivingFace

element_fields.help_en:
The URL of the image to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is an image detection task structure (image table). A maximum of 10 elements are supported, meaning up to 10 images can be detected simultaneously. We recommend using OSS links in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in regions other than Shanghai, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.

> The system automatically converts OSS link addresses to internal network addresses before downloading files, so calling this API does not incur OSS traffic charges
element_fields.help_zh:
待检测的图像URL地址。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个图片检测任务结构体（image表）。最多支持10个元素，即同时最多对10张图片进行检测。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。

> 对于该接口，系统会自动将OSS链接地址转成内网地址然后再下载文件，所以调用该接口并不会产生OSS流量计费
element_fields.name: image_url

parameters.help_en: The array of image URLs to be detected
parameters.help_zh: 待检测的图像URL地址数组
parameters.name: tasks
